prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A single, ornate golden chalice stands majestically at the center of the composition, elevated against a dark, softly glowing background. The chalice is richly decorated with intricate baroque patterns and flourishes, its stem wrapped by a delicate, spiraling vine motif. Ethereal golden light radiates from within the cup, casting luminous sparks and swirling tendrils of energy that arc upward and outward, illuminating the surrounding space with a magical, almost divine aura. The edges of the frame are adorned with elaborate gold filigree, enhancing the sense of opulence and grandeur. The color palette is dominated by warm golds and deep shadows, with subtle hints of amber and bronze. The lighting is dramatic and focused, creating a high-contrast, cinematic effect that highlights the textures and details of the chalice. The overall style is reminiscent of fantasy illustration or high-fantasy concept art, with a sense of reverence and mysticism. The camera angle is straight-on, emphasizing the symmetry and centrality of the chalice, while a shallow depth of field keeps the background softly blurred, drawing all attention to the radiant artifact.
